title: [Power of owner of premises to place pipes and drains through land belonging to other persons.]
text:
254. [Power of owner of premises to place pipes and drains through land belonging to other persons.]

_Omitted by s. 96, ibid. (w.e.f. 1-10-1993)._

255. [Power to require railway level, etc., to be raised or lowered.] Omitted by s. 96, _ibid._

(w.e.f. 1-10-1993).
